This small plot is my perennial garden, maybe some coffee or enset with banana and vegetables between the trees. I cannot afford chemical fertilizer for this small plot — I save what little I can buy for the maize and teff on my bigger fields. But I collect manure from our animals and put it around the trees, that is what keeps them healthy. I weed and tend it myself with my children's help; it is close to the house so I check on it often. The rains here in Oromia are usually enough for perennials, and I have no pump or pipes to irrigate.
